title: Figure 1 - Scope of API 14C vs API 17V; Figure 2 - Examples of Safety Device Identification; Figure 3 - Offshore Production Facility Safety Flow Chart
description: Figure 1 shows the boundary between topside/API 14C and subsea/API 17V safety systems (DHSV/SSSV, SCSSV, BSDV, SDV, production tree, manifold, umbilicals, flying leads, SCU, HPU, EPU, PSS); Figure 3 is the offshore production facility safety flow chart; Annex figures cover dry-tree wellhead flowlines and SAFE/cause-and-effect logic
publisher: API RP 14C, 8th edition (2017), Analysis, Design, Installation, and Testing of Safety Systems for Offshore Production Facilities
